integrity_statement: A standalone standard-library program enumerates the complete finite cell complex and its 35 classwise signed cellular traces, checks the finite sums and the connectedness premise. Only self-review has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The computation gives a complete virtual rational homology character and two parity-forcing Specht coefficients, not graded Betti numbers, integral homology, or a homotopy classification. Equivalent unindexed prior work remains possible.
title: Mixed-parity homology forced by the symmetry character of \(\operatorname{Hom}(P,K_4)\)
